headline: 1 death, 113 hospitalizations: Dengue claims another life in 24 hours
summary: Health authorities report one more death and 113 new admissions to hospitals as the dengue outbreak continues to put pressure on the healthcare system.
details: One person has died from dengue fever in the last 24 hours, according to recent health reports.
A total of 113 patients were admitted to various hospitals across the country for treatment of the virus.
The surge in hospitalizations highlights the ongoing struggle to control the spread of the Aedes mosquito-borne illness.
Authorities continue to urge citizens to keep their surroundings clean to prevent mosquito breeding sites.
caption:

headline: Youth killed in Narsingdi turf war clash
